policies.source_retention: Reuse the original compressed stream only when the structurally encoded decoded content is unchanged.
policies.placement: Resolve active consumers from fresh canonical AS listings; extraction offsets are not relocation addresses.
policies.capacity: Original encoded slots are fixed; bank, canonical RAM and protected-tail checks apply before export. Object respawn capacity excludes reserved index zero; object and bumper X must be nondecreasing; live ring-group X must be below 0x8000.
policies.core_enigma: Use the local S2 decoder and pinned Core encoder; validate emitted streams with the local decoder.
policies.driver_program: The private compressed driver is a reference for code assembled from source, not an editable content ledger.
